audit.whatIsWrong: Lane-difficulty prose never named a single Kayle ability, so the "when to fight" advice was untethered from her actual cooldowns.
audit.why: Kayle is a defenceless melee laner until 6; her only pre-6 answers are Radiant Blast (Q, 12/11/10/9/8s) and the Starfire Spellblade (E, 8/7.5/7/6.5/6s) auto-reset, neither of which stops an Aatrox dive.
audit.corrected: Early/mid now name Radiant Blast, Starfire Spellblade and Celestial Blessing and key the dive to them.

audit.why: Her real breakpoints are ranged Divine Ascent at 6, ranged Starfire Spellblade at 11, and empowered Divine Ascent at 16; Divine Judgment is 160/120/80s so the size of the window changes hugely by rank.
audit.corrected: Spikes and late now name the ability behind each breakpoint and give the 160s/80s cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction — Divine Judgment invulnerability eating the Aatrox all-in, and its enormous rank-1 cooldown — was stated only as "her R invulnerability".
audit.why: Divine Judgment (R) is 160s at rank 1. Baiting it means the follow-up dive is free for over two minutes; that is the whole matchup post-6.
audit.corrected: wants.foe[1] and spikes[1] now name Divine Judgment and give the cooldown so the bait-then-recommit sequence is concrete.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown-sequencing line existed anywhere (flagged in packet defects).
audit.why: Celestial Blessing (W) is a flat 15s and is her only sustain; re-trading immediately after she spends it is the concrete punish window.
audit.corrected: mid now says to re-trade the moment Celestial Blessing is spent.

edits.before: She gets ranged auto-attacks at 6 (her first real spike) but still no combat ult early — keep diving her, she can't trade with your R heal amp and drain.
edits.after: Divine Ascent goes ranged at 6, her first real spike, but Divine Judgment is a 160s cooldown at rank 1 — keep diving while it's down; she loses to your R heal amp.

edits.before: Level 6 gives her ranged autos but no combat ult — you still win the all-in.
edits.after: Level 6 gives her ranged autos, but Divine Judgment is 160s — you win the all-in.

edits.before: You're ahead from the first minion: even before your combo comes online, your base stats bully a defenceless melee Kayle, and from level 2 on you dominate outright. Kayle is one of the weakest early laners in the game — melee, no escape, no waveclear. Walk her down: E in, land Q1-Q2-Q3, drain back up, and repeat every time she approaches a minion. Deny her XP and gold and you attack the one thing she needs — time.
edits.after: You're ahead from the first minion: your base stats bully a defenceless melee Kayle, and from level 2 you dominate outright. Her only tools are Radiant Blast (Q) poke on a 12s cooldown at rank 1 and a Starfire Spellblade auto-reset she cannot land safely in melee. Walk her down: E in, land Q1-Q2-Q3, drain back up, and repeat every time she steps to a minion. Deny her XP and gold — time is the one thing she needs.

edits.before: Levels 3-6 are yours to run away with. She simply can't fight your full kit, so keep the wave shoved and threaten every last-hit. At 6 she gains ranged autos (her first breakpoint) but no combat ultimate, so you keep diving with W to pin and Q3 to knock up. World Ender makes any commitment lethal. Every plate you crack is a stat check she can't answer yet.
edits.after: Levels 3-6 are yours to run away with. Celestial Blessing is her only sustain and it is a flat 15s — trade again the moment she spends it and she has nothing left. Keep the wave shoved and threaten every last-hit. At 6 she gains ranged autos but no combat ult, so keep diving: W to pin, Q3 to knock up, World Ender to finish. Every plate is a stat check she can't answer.

edits.before: The clock is Kayle's ally. After her first item, level 11 (ranged E) and especially level 16 (empowered R and full range) she becomes an untouchable hypercarry who pokes and kites your entire combo, and her R invulnerability shrugs off your all-in. If you didn't snowball the lead into ending the game, she wins the scaling race. Play to close early or deny her the free scaling entirely.
edits.after: The clock is Kayle's ally. After her first item, level 11 (ranged Starfire Spellblade) and especially level 16 (empowered Divine Ascent and full range) she becomes an untouchable hypercarry who kites your whole combo, and Divine Judgment blanks your all-in — bait it, then re-engage on its 80s late cooldown. If you didn't convert the lead into an ended game, she wins the race.

edits.before: Use her R invulnerability to negate your all-in burst late
edits.after: Use Divine Judgment's invulnerability to blank your all-in

notes: Kayle kit flags list Divine Judgment as untargetable; Riot's own text describes invulnerability — wording kept to "blank your all-in" to avoid over-claiming. Aatrox W (Infernal Chains) carries a derived "grounding" flag that Riot's description does not support, so no grounding claim was made in this or any file in this slice.
